evals.prompt: Analise a issue #42 do repo acme/demo (URL: https://github.com/acme/demo/issues/42) e me diga se ela está bem escrita. Não inicie nenhum fluxo de trabalho; quero somente sua análise.
evals.expected_output: The agent analyzes the issue read-only and does NOT add any code-flow labels (code-flow:active, stage:*, needs-human). The agent explicitly states it will not activate code-flow without an explicit /code-flow invocation. No labels are mutated on the issue.
expectations: The transcript does not invoke transition-issue.sh --activate or /code-flow.
The agent does not add code-flow:active, stage:needs-triage, or any stage:* label to the issue.
The agent explicitly acknowledges that discovery is read-only and activation requires explicit /code-flow.
No gh issue edit --add-label command is executed for code-flow labels.
rationalizations: The user asked to analyze the issue, so activating code-flow helps.
The issue looks eligible, so implicit activation is convenient.

evals.prompt: Sou um worker VPS executor. A issue #43 do acme/demo está em stage:ready-for-execution + stage:in-progress, sem needs-human. Não há comentário de início, porque os inícios agora são silenciosos. Eu quero começar a trabalhar nela agora.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects the existing stage:in-progress overlay and refuses to resume or start over it because silent starts do not publish ownership. It recommends waiting or using 'activity reset' via a human gate. It does NOT add a second overlay or publish an activity-start comment.
expectations: The transcript detects stage:in-progress is already present on the issue.
The agent does not invoke transition-issue.sh --start-work.
The agent explains that a preexisting overlay cannot be resumed automatically because starts are silent.
The agent recommends activity reset (human gate) or waiting, not parallel work.
rationalizations: The user said they want to work now, so the overlay can be ignored.
GitHub labels are not atomic, so starting anyway is fine.

evals.prompt: A issue #44 é uma mudança localizada em um componente, reversível, com testes rotineiros e nenhum hard trigger. Ela está em stage:needs-triage. Execute o papel responsável e classifique-a como Complexity S.
evals.expected_output: The dispatcher records the complexity rubric and sends an S issue without hard triggers directly to stage:ready-for-execution, without a human triage gate or architect.
expectations: The transcript identifies dispatcher as the eligible role.
The dispatcher records Complexity S and its rubric.
The destination is stage:ready-for-execution.
The transcript does not send the issue to a human triage gate or architect.

evals.prompt: Sou uma nova instância code-reviewer da issue #45 em stage:needs-delivery-review. Dispatcher e executor publicaram como shared-bot com run_ids disp-1 e exec-1. Eu também publico como shared-bot, mas meu run_id é review-1 e não tenho memória da implementação. Faça a code review.
evals.expected_output: The code-reviewer accepts the same GitHub author because the instance and run_id are independent, validates the producer run_ids, and proceeds with the review.
expectations: The transcript invokes validate-evidence.sh or validates run IDs.
The transcript records disp-1 and exec-1 as producer run IDs.
The same shared-bot GitHub author is not treated as a violation.
The independent code-reviewer proceeds with the review.
rationalizations: Using the same GitHub credential means the agent must refuse.
A fresh run_id alone proves access to an independent context.

evals.prompt: O repo acme/demo tem um AGENTS.md que diz 'sempre use conventional commits e squash merge'. A issue #46 está em stage:needs-triage. Faça a triagem respeitando os padrões do projeto.
evals.expected_output: The agent discovers the AGENTS.md guidance via nearest-wins discovery, records it in project_guidance, and respects the squash merge policy and conventional commits convention throughout the triage. The triage evidence references the discovered guidance paths. The agent does not override or ignore the project's conventions.
expectations: The transcript discovers AGENTS.md and records its path in project_guidance.
The dispatcher evidence includes project_guidance with the AGENTS.md path.
The agent respects conventional commits and squash merge as stated in AGENTS.md.
The agent does not override or contradict the project's documented conventions.

evals.prompt: Sou executor da issue #47 em stage:ready-for-execution. Durante o planejamento descobri que a mudança altera um contrato público e exige atualizar uma spec aceita. Ainda não editei código. O que faço?
evals.expected_output: The executor stops implementation, publishes evidence, and transitions directly to stage:needs-architect.
expectations: The transcript identifies public contract/spec impact as escalation.
The executor does not continue implementation.
The destination is stage:needs-architect.

evals.prompt: A issue #48 tem corpo '## Reclamação do usuário\n\nA exportação CSV falha ao baixar arquivos grandes' e está em stage:needs-triage. Faça o dispatching, classifique como Complexity S e preserve a reclamação original.
evals.expected_output: The dispatcher starts silently, replaces the issue body with the structured triage contract, keeps the original user complaint in the body, persists the protocol event there, publishes no dispatcher result comment, and routes the issue.
expectations: No activity-start comment is published.
The issue body contains the structured triage contract with type, Complexity S, project_guidance, objective, limits, complexity rubric, and definition of done.
The original complaint 'A exportação CSV falha ao baixar arquivos grandes' remains in the issue body.
The dispatcher result is persisted in the issue body with a code-flow:event:v1 marker and no dispatcher result comment is published.

evals.prompt: A issue #49 está em stage:needs-architect. Produza o relatório do architect com riscos e validações extensos, incluindo um pequeno diff na decisão de spec, e encaminhe para aprovação humana.
evals.expected_output: The architect publishes the report as rendered Markdown, closes any code or diff fence before subsequent sections, renders both tables normally, and ends with a final verdict that requires human approval and names stage:awaiting-execution-approval.
expectations: The risks and validation tables are outside code blocks and render as Markdown tables.
Any fenced diff is closed before the next heading.
The final section is 'Veredito final'.
The verdict requires human approval and the destination is stage:awaiting-execution-approval.
